Game Overview

Tap Trap puts players into a tap experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Tap Trap doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Tap Trap?

Tap Trap is a free tap game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Tap Trap free to play?

Yes, Tap Trap is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
